findings.issue: sourceFamilyParents now returns {root,family,version,opened}, but publishRetainedInScope still calls checkSourceDirectory(parents.retained) twice. The field does not exist, so every new retained publication fails.
findings.required: Update both retained caller checks to the actual shared helper family field; preserve all prior retained publication behavior and shared helper contract.

findings.issue: Captured publication parents are not rechecked after the source-view refresh on the created retained/unique paths, and the unique EEXIST recovery branch omits their revalidation entirely. A refreshed view can bind a replacement family after publication while the old captured parent is closed without a final check.
findings.required: On every successful created or recovered publication path, revalidate all held root/family/version directory bindings after the final refresh and before cleanup/acknowledgment. Keep those checks within the primary-failure capture so cleanup preserves the first failure and the outer possible-publication flag yields uncertainty. Do not change refresh semantics or introduce rebinding.
